justification: Changes which clauses the plan brief shows to a house in ten councils: 69 clauses written for other building types or named sites are added to the skip list and the heading scan is updated to match. Data and config only, no code. Directionality: a wrong skip hides a right clause (shows 'not found' for that topic); a missed skip leaves a wrong-type clause visible. Both are measured by OC-29 and OC-30.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The proven rule for a house is no longer in the top 5 after the skip list is applied, and overall recall drops under 90%. It reads the live project_brief_rows and the proven answer cells from dcp_setback_controls plus the hand-made hold-out file, so it cannot be satisfied by editing the skip list alone.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Proven rules come from dcp_setback_controls rows whose quote_status is verbatim against the council PDF, and data/plan_brief_gold_holdout.json. Wrong-type headings were read in the council's own PDF page tops and table of contents (Penrith Part D2, Wollongong B1, Waverley C2/E, Hornsby Part 3, Ku-ring-gai Parts 8 and 14, Northern Beaches Warringah G1/G6/G7).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With all 74 removals applied: OC-30 FAIL 'proven rule in the top 5: 41/47 = 87% overall (lower 95% bound 75%); hold-out 15/20 = 75% (bound 53%); bar 90%' and OC-29 FAIL 'penrith private_open_space: no clause is left to show; blacktown landscaping_min: no clause is left to show; recall under 80% for ashfield 1/2, hornsby 5/10; overall recall 87% over 47 proven cells'. With the 5 disputed removals left in: OC-30 HOLDS 45/47 = 96%. The check went red on the real change before the fix.

pre_impl.existing_data: brief-scope.json listed 114 excluded ids. Baseline OC-29 and OC-30 both held (96%, 45/47). A revised scanner flagged 80 more served clauses; 69 are applied here, 5 are held back because the hold-out answer sheet counts them as proven, and 6 Georges River or Northern Beaches rows were judged applicable.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The scanner's flags were assumed to be right where it disagreed with the answer sheet. Four Hornsby clauses from the 3.2, 3.3 and 3.4 apartment and medium-density tables are marked all_housing in the hold-out sheet, which the check reads as dwelling house. They are held back, not overridden, so the test is not moved to pass.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new file, script or table. The existing skip list and scan file are extended in place, and the existing loader scripts/load_project_brief.py writes the 3 Blacktown landscaping replacements separately as a dry run first, backed up, in build applies-when-20261109T105740.

functions.name: excluded_provision_ids (served-scope skip list)
functions.what: Lists clause ids the brief API drops before showing a house its rules.
functions.input: provision ids of clauses read against the council's own headings as being for another building type, a named place or an ancillary structure
functions.output: 188 ids, up from 114; Hornsby 4 and Ashfield 1 disputed ids are not added
functions.if_none: An empty list shows every stored clause, including ones for apartments or child care.
functions.edge_cases: A topic left with no clause shows the plain 'not found' text; Penrith private_open_space is declared in known_empty_topics because section 1 of Part D2 has no open space figure.
functions.failure_mode: A right clause skipped by mistake hides it and the topic shows 'not found'; this is visible, not a wrong number.

break_it.scenario: A skipped clause is the proven answer for a house.
break_it.what_happens: Recall on proven rules falls and the brief shows the wrong or no clause for that topic.
break_it.how: OC-30 measures recall on 47 proven cells after the skip. The full 74 removals took it from 96% to 87% and failed; the 5 disputed ids are held back and recall is 96% again.

break_it.scenario: A topic loses its last clause.
break_it.what_happens: The brief shows an empty row for a house in that council, which looks like a missing rule.
break_it.how: OC-29 fails when a core topic has no clause left unless the topic is in known_empty_topics. Blacktown landscaping was refilled with 3 house rules; Penrith private open space is declared a gap after reading the PDF.

break_it.scenario: The heading scan file disagrees with the skip list.
break_it.what_happens: A clause is flagged in the scan but still shown, or shown without ever being read.
break_it.how: OC-29 fails if a live top-5 clause was never scanned or a flagged clause would still show. 71 rows were re-marked flagged and 3 Blacktown rows added, and OC-29 holds.

break_it.scenario: The scanner misses a wrong-type clause.
break_it.what_happens: A clause for another building type stays visible.
break_it.how: The revised scanner catches 83% of wrong-type clauses on a fresh 40-clause test; about 1 in 6 gets through. Not closed here.
break_it.repro: labels.json and holdout_labels.json in the scan scratch folder

Blacktown landscaping_min R2 and ANY ranks 1 to 3 now point at 202432, 202271, 202272; the load was a dry run first (6 valid rows), then applied, build applies-when-20261109T105740.
